newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania government and opposition swap fish, rod.
newsitem.headline: Romania government and opposition swap fish, rod.

text.p: Romania's centrist government and the ex-communist opposition swapped fishy offerings during a parliamentary debate on Friday -- a large carp in exchange for a fishing rod.

Daniela Popa, a member of the opposition Party of Social Democracy (PDSR), handed Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea the rod at the start of a debate on an opposition confidence motion denouncing government reforms.
Her gesture was intended to mock Ciorbea's account last month of a Chinese parable of self-reliance in which it is deemed better to give a starving man a fishing rod than a fish.
Ciorbea's aide later appeared later with the 5 kg (11 pound) carp on a tin platter and placed it squarely in front of PDSR senior leader Adrian Nastase.
"This is to show you that my parable produced results," Ciorbea told the chamber to loud laughter. Members endorsed his policies by overwhelmingly rejecting the motion.
